title: Nous Research funding: secondary 'in talks' report treated as confirmed
description: v1 recorded a TechCrunch article headlined 'in talks for new funding at $1.5B valuation' and synthesized a summary asserting the $75M Series B had closed. The secondary report does not support a closed-raise claim; the primary/official confirmation is absent.

provenance.source: Hermes Newsroom v1 dev profile (read-only extraction)
provenance.note: Demonstrates v1 conflating rumor with reported status and secondary with primary.

reviewer_notes: No primary source was retrieved by v1. expected_primary_sources is intentionally empty to mark the gap.
